name: GPU TSDF Fusion with Voxel Hashing
definition: A TSDF (Truncated Signed Distance Function) fusion method that uses voxel hashing for sparse memory allocation, free-space carving to remove artifacts, and voxel levels (multi-resolution) based on distance from the camera. It is implemented as the 'tsdf' option for reconstructDenseGpu.
summary: GPU TSDF Fusion with Voxel Hashing is a fast, sparse memory method for 3D reconstruction that trades lower accuracy for significant speed gains over pixel fusion.
